raw.title: Bump the publishing group across 1 directory with 2 updates
raw.body:
Bumps the publishing group with 2 updates in the / directory: [@umbrelladocs/linkspector](https://github.com/UmbrellaDocs/linkspector) and [respec](https://github.com/speced/respec). Updates `@umbrelladocs/linkspector` from 0.5.5 to 0.5.6
Release notes

Sourced from @​umbrelladocs/linkspector's releases.

v0.5.6

What's Changed

  • Ignore lines via comments by @​gaurav-nelson in UmbrellaDocs/linkspector#183
  • chore(deps): bump js-yaml from 5.2.0 to 5.2.2 by @​dependabot[bot] in UmbrellaDocs/linkspector#185

Full Changelog: https://github.com/UmbrellaDocs/linkspector/compare/v0.5.5...v0.5.6

Commits
  • 0c68856 Merge pull request #185 from UmbrellaDocs/dependabot/npm_and_yarn/js-yaml-5.2.2
  • 42eb6fa chore(deps): bump js-yaml from 5.2.0 to 5.2.2
  • b29682a Merge pull request #183 from UmbrellaDocs/ignore-lines-via-comments
  • 8ae8f7e fix: getDisabledLines to support markdown text
  • 2b5deff chore: fix prettier issues
  • c65e5ac chore: update dependencies and configuration for vitest
  • c63aad3 feat: implement inline ignore comments for link checking
  • 714f4d4 feat: add sponsorship section to README and update FUNDING.yml
  • See full diff in compare view
